notes: Reviewed creator profile for Alibaba Cloud, the creator of the Qwen family. Seeds are canonical Qwen-team-owned URLs; the tool describes and never fetches them.

This profile retires the Alibaba deferral recorded in profiles/origins/README.md. The creator entity was unresolved there; it is resolved here on the Qwen team's own Hugging Face organization profile, and the competing attribution is carried in `ambiguities` rather than dropped.

terminology.family: Alibaba Cloud's open-model family is Qwen, versioned by generation: Qwen3, Qwen3.5, Qwen3.8. A generation is the family; the weight sets published inside it are releases.
terminology.release: A named weight set within a generation, e.g. Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B or Qwen3.8-27B. The suffix encodes size: a bare figure is a dense parameter count, and a total-A-active pair is a mixture-of-experts total and active count.
terminology.variant: Instruct, Thinking and Base suffixes are variants of a release within its generation, not separate families.
terminology.serving: Qwen weights are published on Hugging Face Hub and ModelScope. Qwen models are also offered by clouds Alibaba Cloud does not operate, including Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, and a hosted Qwen3.8-Max service exists that is not the same artefact as the published weights.

naming_rules.subject: family
naming_rules.rule: The family is the Qwen generation. Do not create a family per model size.
naming_rules.example: Qwen3.8-27B and Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B both belong to the Qwen3.8 family.

naming_rules.subject: release
naming_rules.rule: The canonical name is the creator's own weight name, dot included. Entity ids and slugs may not contain a dot, so the generation number is hyphenated there while the canonical name keeps it.
naming_rules.example: canonicalName Qwen3.8-27B, id alibaba-qwen3-8-27b, slug qwen3-8-27b.

naming_rules.subject: parameters
naming_rules.rule: Read the size suffix literally and never infer an active count for a dense release.
naming_rules.example: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B is 2400B total and 95B active; Qwen3.8-27B is 27B total with no active count.

naming_rules.subject: license
naming_rules.rule: Licences differ between releases in the same generation. Never carry one across the family.
naming_rules.example: Qwen3.8-27B is Apache-2.0 while Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B is under a licence of the creator's own drafting.

source_catalog.trust_notes: The Qwen team's own Hugging Face organization and the model cards published under it. Authoritative for creator attribution, parameter counts, context lengths and licence metadata.
source_catalog.verification: Reached 2026-08-28. The organization profile states that Qwen "refers to the large language model family built by Alibaba Cloud" and gives https://qwen.ai/ as the organization website.

source_catalog.trust_notes: The Qwen team's GitHub organization. Each generation repository carries a dated News list, which is the only primary record of release dates that could be reached.
source_catalog.verification: Reached 2026-08-28 at https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3.8, whose News list is dated 2026-08-12 and 2026-08-14.

notes: Take release dates from the generation repository's News list, not from Hugging Face commit timestamps, which record uploads rather than announcements.
Take parameter counts, context length and licence from the model card, which states each explicitly.
Never extract an organization, family or authorship claim from a third-party cloud's catalogue page. Such a page supports a deployment and nothing else.
Do not record qwencloud.com as a serving platform until a source states who operates it; the site does not say, and it also serves other creators' models.

ambiguities.note: The Hugging Face organization attributes Qwen to Alibaba Cloud, while the QwenLM/Qwen3.8 repository description credits "Qwen team, Alibaba Group", the parent company. Both wordings are the creator's own.
ambiguities.guidance: Record Alibaba Cloud, on the organization profile, and carry the Alibaba Group wording in the organization description. Treat either name appearing in a future source as expected rather than as a new contradiction.

ambiguities.topic: Published weights versus the hosted Max service
ambiguities.note: The Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B card describes Qwen3.8-Max as "the official version based on Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B with more features, such as vision input & non-thinking support, 1M context length by default".
ambiguities.guidance: These are different artefacts. Do not copy the hosted service's modalities or context length onto the published weights.

ambiguities.note: Cards state a native context length and a larger ceiling reached with YaRN scaling, and the ceilings differ between releases in the same generation.
ambiguities.guidance: Record the native figure as the context window and leave the extended ceiling to prose. An extension technique is a property of how a model is run, not of the weights.

ambiguities.topic: The creator's own site cannot be read
ambiguities.note: qwen.ai and qwen.ai/blog render client-side and return no text to a fetch; qwenlm.github.io last published on 2025-09-23 and redirects to qwen.ai.
ambiguities.guidance: Use the Hugging Face organization and the QwenLM repositories. Never cite qwen.ai for a fact no fetch could actually read.
